title: Create Peripheral Fix
description: This mod fixes Create's peripherals on 1.20.1 so that they act as valid inventory targets.
body:
# Create Peripheral Fix
This mod makes Create's peripherals that have inventories work as valid Inventory targets.
![Screenshot of a CC computer making a transfer to a Packager](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/31169cb570143118d8c621983db0bb2ddc30a9fe.png)
